| **SAIRNbiz / StoneDesk** | **Item 58: three-way match &mdash; StoneDesk has ALL THREE documents and NOT ONE FIELD that joins them; SAIRNbiz has none of them** | **AUDITED 2026-09-14 (CC)** &mdash; `docs/2026-09-14-three-way-match-audit.md`. **Nothing changed, nothing gated**, as instructed | **Michael** (the SAIRNbiz half is a product decision) | &mdash; | **SAIRNbiz is a ZERO-way match and the documents do not exist.** `saveBill()` creates a payable from one form &mdash; vendor, amount, optional invoice number, one person &mdash; and posts `bill_received` to the ledger immediately; `sbPayBill()` settles it **from that same internally-created row**, no second document, no second person, no amount re-entry, and posts `bill_paid`. `grep -ciE "purchase order\|receiving\|packing slip\|bill of lading" sairnbiz.html` returns **0**: the match is not skipped, **two of the three documents do not exist**. **WHAT BOUNDS IT, AND IT CHANGES THE SEVERITY A LOT:** `sbPayBill()` says so itself &mdash; *"recorded in this app only, no payment was sent"*. **The app moves no money.** The exposure is a wrong set of BOOKS, not a wrong disbursement. The accounting shape is right: receipt and payment are two entries rather than an edit, each with its own `source_kind`/`source_id` for idempotence. It is the AUTHORISATION shape that is absent. **STONEDESK IS THE INTERESTING ONE &mdash; it is most of the way there and does not know it.** All three legs are real, shipped and reachable: purchase orders (`sd_pos` / `sdPOCreate`), receiving (`sd_receiving` / `sdRecvLog`), invoices (`sd_invoices`). And `grep -cE "po_id\|poId\|purchase_order_id\|receiving_id\|recv_id\|receipt_id"` returns **0 in BOTH files.** **Not one field links any of the three to either of the others**, so a three-way match here is not unenforced &mdash; **it is unconstructible.** The receiving log even records its own `value`, typed by whoever booked the delivery, with no reference to the PO amount: two independently-typed money figures for one delivery and no mechanism, not even a manual one, that puts them side by side. **ONE INCIDENTAL DEFECT FOUND ON THE PATH:** `sdPOCreate()` mints `'PO-2024-0'+(50+d.length)` &mdash; **derived from ARRAY LENGTH, so deleting any PO makes the next one reuse a number already issued**, and **the year is hardcoded to 2024**. Recorded, not fixed, because the instruction was audit only. **THE SMALLEST THING THAT CHANGES THE ANSWER:** StoneDesk needs ONE FIELD &mdash; a `po_num` on the receiving record and on the invoice &mdash; after which a report-only instrument could show POs with no receipt, receipts with no PO, and amount differences. **SAIRNbiz needs a decision before it needs code:** at one-or-two-person scale the three-way match is often deliberately not run, and the honest control is a second pair of eyes rather than a second system | M |
